query:
SELECT d.id::text AS "id!", document_drive_path(d.folder_id, d.name) AS "path!"
           FROM documents d
           JOIN document_folders f ON f.id = d.folder_id
           WHERE (f.id = $1::text::uuid OR $1::text::uuid = ANY(f.ancestor_ids))
             AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
           ORDER BY d.id
